name: Opções Flexíveis – Registro de Opção VCP e Curvas Calculadas (V2)
manual_section: 5.3.1 Registro de Contrato de Opção VCP e Curvas Calculadas (V 2)
description: Layout used by the participant to register a VCP flexible option contract (and calculated-curve options) with B3. One header line, one data line (type 1) per option and, for contracts with an Asian average, one fixing line (type 2) per verification date.
file_name_rule: OPC_Banco.txt (Opt Commodities) or FXO_Banco.txt (Opt FXO), written to the Batch Conecta 'New' folder (CONECTA_NEW_PATH); an existing name gets a ' (n)' copy suffix.
notes: Written by routes.api_send_conecta (Opt Commodities → OPC_Banco.txt) and routes.api_fxo_send_conecta (Opt FXO → FXO_Banco.txt). Both write semicolon-delimited lines exactly as the manual specifies: each record ends with a trailing ';' (the manual prints a 'Separador X(1)' row after every field — those rows are represented here by file_type/separator, not listed as fields). Data lines carry all 62 fields (63 ';'-separated tokens including the trailing empty one); unfilled fields go out empty. Deals with Status 'Canceled' are skipped. Numbers use the decimal comma the manual requires. FXO caveat: the code's docstring says Tipo de Cotação (field 18) = '2', but the code writes '1' — this template documents what the code writes.
